caption: Real FLIR thermal frame, same input as the AI
rules: person: exactly one person, tight to the body, no road / vehicle / crosswalk, a pose plausible for a trapped person; decoy and not-person: a warm object filling the frame, never a whole car on a street. All frames held out from training; picked and checked by eye from contact sheets (ml/real_crops.py cands).
